text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Mozambican Education Ministry is seeking assistance from the international community to help finance a $400 million plan for education between 1998 and 2002. The aim is to improve the quality of education and to raise school attendance from the current 40 percent.

- Portuguese Minister of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries Fernando Gomes da Silva is in Maputo for talks on speeding up implementation of agricultural cooperation accords already signed by Portugal and Mozambique.
